# Clinched

> Round-by-round history of every Formula 1 drivers' championship from 1950, with results up to 1 November 2026.

Each season page states the champion, margin, deciding round and a round-by-round table of the leader. Data comes from F1DB (CC BY 4.0). Please credit Clinched and link to the season page.

## Guides
- [Closest F1 title fights](https://vmurthy45.github.io/clinched/closest-f1-title-fights/)
- [Titles decided at the last race](https://vmurthy45.github.io/clinched/f1-titles-decided-at-the-last-race/)
- [Earliest title wins](https://vmurthy45.github.io/clinched/earliest-f1-title-wins/)
- [Champions under other points systems](https://vmurthy45.github.io/clinched/f1-champions-under-other-points-systems/)
- [Every F1 world champion](https://vmurthy45.github.io/clinched/f1-world-champions-list/)
- [How F1 points changed](https://vmurthy45.github.io/clinched/f1-points-system-history/)
